prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is approached, then take it, if heavy call assistance. Approach object, scan its properties, move randomly. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = CallAssistance    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <SubTree ID = ScanObjectProperties    /> <Action ID = MoveToRandomLocation    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectHeavy    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsObjectHeavy? THEN
				DO CallAssistance
		END
	END
